application.name: Macro Technical Pulse
application.purpose: Capture and gather economic and market data streams, store them for feature engineering and machine-learning price-prediction models, deploy trained models on live streams, and provide visualization of the collected data, engineered features, signals, and predictions. Technical-response measurement may later analyze price sensitivity to external signals, but it is not the application's primary purpose.

value: no autonomous brokerage or order execution
no investment-advice claims
no committed credentials
provider data, exchange observations, and third-party artifacts retain their own licensing and usage terms
publication, availability, and receipt chronology must remain distinguishable where source behavior requires it
no owner-approved monetary budget or delivery deadline is currently established

deployment_context.value: Begin with local development and CI while establishing source-data collection and API consumption. Address explicit schemas and database storage next. Subsequent phases must support visualization, feature-engineering and model-development workflows, followed by deployment of trained models on live data streams. The database technology, live-stream infrastructure, model-serving topology, update policy, rollback policy, and operational service levels remain undecided. Live model deployment does not authorize broker connectivity or order execution.

value: exact source and provider provenance
source publication, availability, and receipt chronology where material
versioned schemas and transformations
point-in-time evaluation that excludes unavailable future information
explicit naive baselines and temporal validation for predictive models
independent model validation and risk review
clear separation of observed, owner-declared, derived, proposed, and unavailable claims
establish reliable economic and market source-data collection and API consumption
define source-data schemas and database storage after ingestion is established
build visualization for collected data, features, signals, and predictions
develop feature-engineering pipelines
develop and validate machine-learning price-prediction models
deploy trained models on live data streams
later evaluate price sensitivity to external signals through technical-response analysis
defer comprehensive revision handling until a working prototype demonstrates the need

risk_tolerance.value: Fail closed when provenance, licensing, or authorization is materially uncertain. Require explicit human approval for publication, notifications, broker connectivity, order execution, destructive actions, or other external writes. Strategy and readiness claims require independent risk review.

review.source: questionnaire answers from owner interview: Jack Rory Staunton
